title: PhilanthroPy: A scikit-learn-native toolkit for leakage-safe donor analytics in nonprofit and academic medical center fundraising
description: PhilanthroPy is a scikit-learn native library for nonprofit and academic medical center (AMC) fundraising analytics - donor propensity, lapse prediction, planned-giving intent, wealth screening, and hybrid revenue forecasting - with leakage-safe, pipeline-compatible estimators.
